$comment: Every image the site shows: where it comes from and how it is prepared. Sources: pdf = 'raphael Studios Story 2026 final.pdf' (page, image xref), psd = Links/<name>.psd (the 2022 layout's linked images, used where they are the same picture at a higher resolution), art = public-domain paintings (see docs/CREDITS.md). 'up' = upscale factor (Real-ESRGAN), 'cut' = cut the subject out (BiRefNet) for the 3D hover, 'depthUnion' = also lift what the depth map says is near (out-of-focus hands etc.), 'depth' = save a depth map, 'max' = longest side of the master.
